title: KV cache near capacity
explanation: KV cache usage is 91.2% (threshold 80%). vLLM will begin evicting and recomputing KV blocks, causing latency spikes and reduced throughput.
suggested_action: Reduce max_model_len or max_num_seqs, enable prefix caching, or migrate to a GPU with more HBM.

title: Queue depth exceeds threshold
explanation: 12 requests are waiting to be scheduled (threshold 10). Requests are arriving faster than the engine can process them.
suggested_action: Increase max_num_seqs if memory allows, enable chunked prefill, or add a replica to distribute load.

title: p95 latency exceeds threshold
explanation: p95 end-to-end latency is 1180.7ms against a threshold of 500ms. Tail latency is degrading user experience.
suggested_action: Investigate queue depth and KV cache pressure. Consider request batching configuration or horizontal scaling.

title: GPU underutilized
explanation: GPU utilization is 24.1% (threshold 30%) with low queue depth. The GPU is provisioned beyond current demand.
suggested_action: Consider right-sizing to a smaller GPU SKU, consolidating workloads, or enabling autoscaling to reduce idle GPU cost.
